purpose: Candidate-specific historical outcome review; diagnostic evidence only and never a promotion decision.
common_opportunity_rule: Use exact replacement-model held-out endpoints with a contemporaneous named setup match. The setup-only and frozen-threshold legs use identical event IDs and the same B1 tape.

comparisons.setup_only: Every common named-setup opportunity, no probability filter.
comparisons.model_threshold: The same opportunities with the frozen B2 OOF threshold for the exact replacement model.
comparisons.full_policy: The same opportunities with the exact replacement-version policy binding, only if that binding is frozen before outcomes; otherwise status is insufficient_evidence and no P&L is reported.

execution.entry: B1 first scheduled open strictly after known_at; offline known_at is completed signal bar plus one second.
execution.position: One ES contract, one instrument position, no opposite position, zero cooldown, 100000 USD nominal accounting.
execution.costs: B1 es_session_cost_v1; report full costs and a declared double-cost stress when a full-policy binding exists.
execution.missing_and_rolls: B1 DATA_GAP/censoring; no holiday inference, no forward search, and coordinate changes are censored.
execution.clean_sample: Held-out endpoints are untouched by fitting, but technical replay inspection occurred before this economic review; no claim is made that this historical sample was untouched from all inspection. The clean boundary is the predeclared prospective C1 sample.

1.reason: Pooled FRVP model; baseline_scope_v1 makes pooled families diagnostic-only, including setup matches.

2.reason: Pooled FRVP model; baseline_scope_v1 makes pooled families diagnostic-only, including setup matches.

11.reason: Pooled ICT model; baseline_scope_v1 makes pooled families diagnostic-only, including setup matches.

prospective_c1.sample_definition: First healthy post-B7 collection timestamp under the new immutable collection identity; full eligible ES session coverage; all selected and rejected same-side named setup opportunities retained.
freeze_before_observation: full-policy binding or explicit no-full-policy status
prospective_c1.review_target: Approximately 20 fully collected sessions and 50-100 resolved matches per branch as a practical review target, not a profitability guarantee.
